name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit a website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems and produce a prioritized, evidence-backed report of findings and suggested actions. Read-only; recommends, never modifies.

skills.summary: Entrypoint. Runs the full audit, composes sub-skill outputs into the single final report.
Reachability and readability: robots.txt bot access, JS-required gates, client-rendered shells, sitemap, noindex, canonical.
Can a machine pick out the specific facts: plain-text key facts, image-only facts, JSON-LD validity, page self-identification.
Trust and identity: entity disambiguation anchors, freshness signals, plain-text identity facts, off-site corroboration surface.
On-site engagement: first-viewport clarity, calls to action, orientation, context retention, mobile readiness, link health.
